successors.name: Spanish Empire
successors.text: Cebu island, where Legazpi founded the Villa del Santisimo Nombre de Jesus in 1565 after Rajah Tupas was overpowered

ledger.x: c. 1400: the port-kingdom of Cebu appears (infobox 'c. 1400-1565'). The page says it 'was founded as early as the 10th Century' and credits Sri Lumay of Sumatra in legend; it gives no founding year.
27 April 1565: Legazpi lands at Cebu and overpowers Rajah Tupas.
1565: the Hindu polity of Cebu ends.

wars.name: Battle of Mactan
wars.outcome: Fought on 27 April 1521; Ferdinand Magellan was killed.

wars.name: Spanish conquest of Cebu
wars.outcome: Legazpi anchored on 13 February 1565, landed on 27 April 1565 and overpowered Rajah Tupas; the Spaniards founded the Villa del Santisimo Nombre de Jesus and made Cebu the capital of the Spanish East Indies until the move to Manila in 1571.

certainty.note: A port polity on one island with named chiefs of the south and north; no survey line.
